What identifies an outside file or folder

Source: R/glow_run_records.R
glow_file_fingerprint.Rd

A unit depends on files that no part of the workflow produced, such as a phenotype table. The record keeps a fingerprint of each one, and a changed fingerprint means changed input.

glow_file_fingerprint(path, md5_limit = 64 * 1024^2, small = 1024^2)

Arguments

path

One path, several paths (a set of files that are read together, such as the per-chromosome files of a folder), or NULL.

md5_limit

Numeric. The largest file, in bytes, whose content is read for a checksum. Default: 64 MB.

small

Numeric. Inside a folder, the largest file, in bytes, whose content is read. Default: 1 MB.

Value

One string. For a file up to md5_limit: md5: and its checksum. For a larger file: its size and modification time, because reading whole-genome files for every unit would cost more than the unit. For a folder: the number of files and a checksum of their names with, per file, the checksum of a file up to small and the size and modification time of a larger one. For several paths: the number of files and a checksum of their names and fingerprints. For a path that does not exist: missing. For NULL: none.

Details

Size and modification time do not prove equal content. They detect a file that was replaced, which is the case the record has to catch, and they miss a replacement that keeps both. The modification time is taken to the microsecond. A folder is listed recursively. Computational complexity: linear in the size of the files that are read, and in the number of files of a folder.

Examples

f <- tempfile(); writeLines("a", f)
glow_file_fingerprint(f)
#> [1] "md5:60b725f10c9c85c70d97880dfe8191b3"
